question: Which team won the first edition of the Women's Premier League (WPL) event in the year 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai Indians**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Mumbai Indians won the inaugural edition of the Women’s Premier League (WPL) held in 2023.
 
• Mumbai Indians defeated Delhi Capitals in the final to claim the championship title.
 
• The final match was held on **March 26, 2023**, at the Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai.
 
• Mumbai Indians, led by **Harmanpreet Kaur**, showcased exceptional performances throughout the tournament.
 
• Nat Sciver-Brunt played a match-winning knock in the final, scoring an unbeaten 60 runs to secure the victory for Mumbai Indians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Women’s Premier League (WPL):**

 
 
• Inaugural edition of the WPL was held in March 2023, marking a milestone in women's cricket.
 
• The league featured five teams: Mumbai Indians, Delhi Capitals, Royal Challengers Bangalore, Gujarat Giants, and UP Warriorz.
 
• The tournament format included a round-robin stage followed by playoffs and a final.
 
 
 
• **Harmanpreet Kaur:**
 
 
• Harmanpreet Kaur is the captain of the Indian Women’s National Cricket Team and led the Mumbai Indians in the WPL 2023.
 
• She is known for her aggressive batting style and exceptional leadership skills.
 
 
 
• **Nat Sciver-Brunt:**
 
 
• An English all-rounder, Nat Sciver-Brunt was a key player for Mumbai Indians in WPL 2023.
 
• She was instrumental in the team’s success, contributing significantly with both bat and ball.
 
 
 
• **Impact of WPL:**
 
 
• The WPL is considered a game-changer for women’s cricket, providing a platform for players to showcase their talent on a global stage.
 
• It is expected to inspire more women to take up cricket professionally and boost the popularity of the sport globally.
